dedupe_keys.name: building energy consumption dataset with derived temporal and weather features a five year hourly record from a commercial building in south africa

description: This release describes five years of hourly electricity use for one South African commercial office building. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0; the provider says its internal CSV has 43,848 rows and 30 fields from 2016 through 2020. Twelve original measurements include kWh and weather variables, while 18 derived fields include calendar indicators, one- and 24-hour energy lags, rolling means and heating or cooling degree hours. Weather values draw on NASA MERRA-2 reanalysis. The time series can calibrate or test building-load forecasts and weather sensitivity before energy-network simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this five-year site series. A limitation is that a single office building cannot represent a national commercial stock. The page does not state missing-data handling, meter boundary, occupancy changes or leakage-safe train/test splits for lagged features. The ZIP was not downloaded, and the row count or variables were not independently verified.
